Description: Manipulates execution speeds and time frequencies across the battle arena.
Co-op Synergy Mechanism: Creates temporal acceleration bubbles that allow nearby allies to execute weapon reload and auto-logic loops up to 50% faster.
Recursive Draft Focus: Cooldown reductions, time distortion fields, faster automated loop triggers.
Recommended Starter Ships (Top 3): 1. Sidewinder Frame, 2. Anaconda Frame, 3. Cobra Frame

Description: Establishes spatial force lines between ships and enemy fleets.
Co-op Synergy Mechanism: Tethers groups of enemies together so single-target damage or status effects dealt by teammates echo across all linked targets.
Recursive Draft Focus: Linking targets, echoing single-target damage across fleets, spatial disruption.
Recommended Starter Ships (Top 3): 1. Python Frame, 2. Cobra Frame, 3. Sidewinder Frame

Description: Converts internal heat and shield pressure into raw electrical power output.
Co-op Synergy Mechanism: Siphons weapon heat generated by teammates to charge map-wide EMP lightning pulses while keeping allies cool.
Recursive Draft Focus: Heat-to-energy conversion, high-voltage EMP discharges, weapon power overclocks.
Recommended Starter Ships (Top 3): 1. Cutter Frame, 2. Python Frame, 3. Cobra Frame

Description: Controls local gravity, singularities, and kinetic momentum forces.
Co-op Synergy Mechanism: Pulls scattered enemy waves into dense geometric clusters so allies' AoE explosives and line beams hit 100% of targets.
Recursive Draft Focus: Clumping enemy waves, black hole fields, kinetic/collision damage amplifiers.
Recommended Starter Ships (Top 3): 1. Chieftain Frame, 2. Type-10 Frame, 3. Krait Frame

Description: Deploys self-replicating metallic bugs that consume armor and rebuild hulls.
Co-op Synergy Mechanism: Infests enemies; when destroyed, they explode into repair swarms that seek out and restore damaged teammate hulls.
Recursive Draft Focus: Self-replicating bug swarms, armor stripping, passive team hull restoration.
Recommended Starter Ships (Top 3): 1. Krait Frame, 2. Type-10 Frame, 3. Cobra Frame

Description: Shifts vessel hitboxes into alternate dimensions to bypass physical threats.
Co-op Synergy Mechanism: Triggers an emergency phase-shift field when allies take fatal damage, rendering the team invulnerable for 1.5 seconds.
Recursive Draft Focus: Temporary invulnerability, phase-dashing through enemies, bypassing shields.
Recommended Starter Ships (Top 3): 1. Sidewinder Frame, 2. Cutter Frame, 3. Anaconda Frame

Recursive Draft Focus: Aura stacking, harmonic team stat multipliers, cross-fleet power feeding.

Recommended Starter Ships (Top 3): 1. Krait Frame, 2. Chieftain Frame, 3. Type-10 Frame
